description: Rules of Materialization: Defines thermodynamic, physical, and psychological conditions required for world-changing actions. In post-scarcity, actions that cost nothing mean nothing; true consequence requires friction, sacrifice, and irreversible expenditure.

actions.name: Erect Physical Sanctuary / Monastery
actions.description: Found a sanctuary free from automated assistance. Requires genuine manual sweat, finite timber, deliberate friction, and unbacked collective sacrifice.
actions.irreversible_outcome: Carves a persistent non-automated pocket into the reality grid that cannot be regenerated or erased by automated sweeps.

actions.name: Deconstruct Automated Node / Terminal
actions.description: Dismantle an automated municipal terminal using mechanical leverage rather than software commands, forcing human attention back onto physical infrastructure.
actions.irreversible_outcome: Creates a localized friction zone where humans must physically manage what was once invisible background magic.

actions.name: Establish Sovereign Hearth & Kitchen
actions.description: Maintain sustenance through manual fire and agriculture without nutritional synthesis.
actions.irreversible_outcome: Transforms eating from passive metabolic intake into a shared communal ritual.

actions.name: Sacrificial Incineration of the Relic
actions.description: Publicly burn a relic of past meritocracy (patents, briefs, credentials) to break the phantom addiction to obsolete hierarchies.
actions.irreversible_outcome: Permanent severance from phantom labor; converts past grievance into present resolve.
